descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 11
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 11 (X122.13 / X121.11). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 12
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 12 (X132.9 / X131.1). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 13
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 13 (X132.10 / X131.2). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 14
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 14 (X132.12 / X131.4). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DI/DO 15
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 15 (X132.13 / X131.5you). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.

descriere_scurta: CU signal source for terminal DO 16
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DO 16 (- / X130.7). To the terminal designation: The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU310.
Setting to invert the signals at the digital outputs.
Sets the simulation mode for digital inputs.

descriere_scurta: CU digital inputs simulation mode setpoint
descriere: Sets the setpoint for the input signals in the digital input simulation mode.
Sets the signal source to block the master control.

descriere_scurta: Command data set selection CDS bit 1
descriere: Sets the signal source to select the Command Data Set bit 1 (CDS bit 1).
Sets the configuration for the motor and encoder changeover.

descriere_scurta: Motor changeover contactor control delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the contactor control for the motor changeover.
Sets the signal source for the command "ON/OFF (OFF1)". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 0 (STW1.0).

Sets the first signal source for the command "No coast down/coast down (OFF2)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0844 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 1" - BI: p0845 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 1 (STW1.1). BI: p0844 = 0 signal or BI: p0845 = 0 signal - OFF2 (immediate pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0844 = 1 signal and BI: p0845 = 1 signal - No OFF2 (enable is possible)

descriere_scurta: No Quick Stop / Quick Stop (OFF3) signal source 1
descriere: Sets the first signal source for the command "No quick stop/quick stop (OFF3)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0848 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 1" - BI: p0849 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 2 (STW1.2). BI: p0848 = 0 signal or BI: p0849 = 0 signal - OFF3 (braking along the OFF3 ramp (p1135), then pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0848 = 1 signal and BI: p0849 = 1 signal - No OFF3 (enable is possible)

Sets the signal source for the command "enable operation/inhibit operation". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 3 (STW1.3). BI: p0852 = 0 signal Inhibit operation (suppress pulses). BI: p0852 = 1 signal Enable operation (pulses can be enabled).

descriere_scurta: Control by PLC/no control by PLC
descriere: Sets the signal source for the command "control by PLC/no control by PLC". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 10 (STW1.10). BI: p0854 = 0 signal No control by PLC BI: p0854 = 1 signal Master control by PLC.

Sets the monitoring time for the power unit. The following applies for infeeds and drives: The monitoring time is started after an 0/1 edge of the ON/OFF1 command. If the power unit does not return a READY signal within the monitoring time, then fault F06000 (infeeds) or F07802 (drives) is output. For drives, the following also applies: After the pulse enable (operation enabled, p0852), the monitoring time is re-started. If the infeed does not signal ready to the drive within the monitoring time (using BI: p0864 of the drive), fault F07840 is initiated.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal from the line contactor.

Sets the monitoring time of the line contactor. This time starts each time that the line contactor switches (r0863.1). If a feedback signal is not received from the line contactor within the time, a message is output.
Sets the delay time for the control command of the power unit and a line contactor, if used.
Sets the signal source for the "system pressure available" signal.
Sets the switch-on threshold to evaluate the measured system pressure.
Sets the hysteresis for the switch-on threshold to evaluate the measured system pressure.

descriere_scurta: Power unit main contactor holding time after OFF1
descriere: Sets the main contactor holding time after OFF1

descriere_scurta: Power unit DC switch debounce time
descriere: Sets the debounce time for the DC circuit breaker for Motor Modules in "chassis" format.
Sets the configuration for the sequence control.

Setting to interconnect the ready signal for mixed operation of Smart Line Module (SLM) and Basic Line Module (BLM). In order that signal BO: r0873 is available at one of the infeeds, then BI: p0874 of the one infeed must be interconnected to BO: r0863.0 of the other infeed.

Sets the configuration for the "ESR" function. 0: No function 1: Extended stopping (integrated in the drive), n_set 2: Extended retraction (integrated in the drive) 3: Generator operation (Vdc controller) 4: Extended stopping (integrated in the drive), n_act

Sets the signal source to enable the response for the "ESR" function. BI: p0889 = 0 signal The ESR response is locked. A possible trigger event that occurs is ignored. BI: p0889 = 1 signal The ESR response is enabled. A possible trigger event that occurs initiates the response.
Sets the OFF ramp for the "ESR" function. 0: OFF3 1: OFF1
Sets the timer for the brake delay for the "ESR" function.

Sets the speed/velocity, which, when triggered, is approached with an OFF3 ramp. The timer in p0892 is the total time that elapses for the approach and constant velocity travel. After this, depending on the setting in p0891, an OFF1 ramp or OFF3 ramp is realized.
Pre-setting for the "Parking axis" and "Parking encoder" function.
Sets the signal source to select the "parking axis" function.
Displays the control word for the function "central measuring probe evaluation".
Sets the number of tolerated consecutive sign-of-life errors of the clock-cycle synchronous master. The sign-of-life signal is normally received in PZD4 (control word 2) from the master.
Number of fault situations that have occurred since the last reset.
Displays the system runtime in ms since the last POWER ON.

The parameter is used to initiate a reset of the parameters of an individual infeed unit. The parameters of the basic commissioning (refer to p0009) are in this case not reset (p0107, p0108, p0121, p0170). These can only be reset using the factory setting of the complete drive unit (p0976). The sampling times (p0111, p0112, p0115) are only not reset if this results in a conflict with the basic clock cycle (p0110).
Setting to save the parameter of the particular drive object in the non-volatile memory. When saving, only the adjustable parameters intended to be saved are taken into account.
Sets the required procedure to execute a hardware reset for the drive unit.

descriere_scurta: is automatically set to 0 and p0009 is automatically set to 1 after this has been carried out.
descriere: Saves all parameters of the drive system to the non-volatile memory. When saving, only the adjustable parameters intended to be saved are taken into account.

Sets the signal source to continually increase the setpoint for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint change (CO: r1050) depends on the set ramp-up time (p1047) and the duration of the signal that is present (BI: p1035).
Sets the scaling for the maximum velocity (p1082). For a higher-level velocity control, this scaling allows the maximum velocity to be briefly exceeded.
Sets the ramp-function generator type.

Sets the signal source for the command "enable ramp-function generator/inhibit ramp-function generator". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 4 (STW1.4). BI: p1140 = 0 signal: Inhibits the ramp-function generator (the ramp-function generator output is set to zero). BI: p1140 = 1 signal: Ramp-function generator enable.

Sets the signal source for the command "continue ramp-function generator/freeze ramp-function generator". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 5 (STW1.5). BI: p1141 = 0 signal: Freezes the ramp-function generator. BI: p1141 = 1 signal: Continue ramp-function generator.

Sets the signal source for the command "enable setpoint/inhibit setpoint". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 6 (STW1.6). BI: p1142 = 0 signal Inhibits the setpoint (the ramp-function generator input is set to zero). BI: p1142 = 1 signal Setpoint enable.
Sets the signal source for "setpoint 2 enable".
Sets the signal source for speed setpoint 1 of the speed controller.
Sets the configuration for the speed setpoint.
Sets the signal source for the position deviation XERR for DSC (position controller output of the higher-level control).
Sets the signal source for the position controller gain KPC for DSC.
Sets the signal source for control word DSC_STW for DSC with spline. Bit 0: DSC with spline on Bit 4: Speed pre-control for DSC with spline on Bit 5: Torque pre-control for DSC with spline on

Sets the signal source for the symmetrizing time constant T_SYMM for DSC with spline. T_SYMM = 0: Symmetrization is de-activated. T_SYMM > 0: The position setpoint is symmetrized with the time constant T_SYMM. For active force precontrol (r1407.20, 21, 22), the velocity precontrol value is symmetrized with the sum of the following time constants: T_SYMM + T_SYMM_ADD (p1427) + 0.5 * velocity controller clock cycle (p0115[1]) Force pre-control value is not symmetrized.
Sets the signal source for the position offset between incremental and absolute position.
Modifies the pre-charging monitoring of the infeed. The active automatic restart (AR) of the following drive object can be interconnected using this binector input (BI:
Sets the automatic restart mode (AR).
Sets the start attempts of the automatic restart function for p1210 = 4, 6.

descriere_scurta: Automatic restart delay time start attempts
descriere: Sets the delay time up to restart.
Sets the holding brake configuration.

Sets the time to apply the motor holding brake. After OFF1 or OFF3 and the holding brake is controlled (the brake closes), then the drive remains closed-loop controlled for this time stationary with a speed setpoint/velocity setpoint of zero. The pulses are suppressed when the time expires.

descriere_scurta: Open motor holding brake signal source threshold
descriere: Sets the signal source for the command "open brake".
Sets the threshold value for the command "open brake".

descriere_scurta: Motor holding brake feedback signal brake closed
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "brake closed". For motor holding brakes with feedback signal, the signal "brake closed" can be activated using p1275.5 = 1.

descriere_scurta: Motor holding brake feedback signal brake open
descriere: Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "brake open". For motor holding brakes with feedback signal, the signal "brake open" can be activated using p1275.5 = 1.
Sets the signal source "threshold value" for the standstill identification.

Sets the monitoring time for the standstill identification. When braking with OFF1 or OFF3, standstill is identified after this time has expired, after the setpoint speed has fallen below p1226 (also refer to p1145). After this, the brake control is started, the system waits for the closing time in p1217 and then the pulses are suppressed.

Sets the delay time for pulse suppression. After OFF1 or OFF3, the pulses are canceled, if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled: - the speed actual value falls below the threshold in p1226 and the time started after this in p1228 has expired. - the speed setpoint falls below the threshold in p1226 and the time started after this in p1227 has expired.

Displays the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller. If p1254 = 0 (automatic sensing of the switch-in level = off), then the following applies: AC/AC device: r1242 = 1.15 * sqrt(2) * p0210 DC/AC device: r1242 = 1.15 * p0210 If p1254 = 1 (automatic sensing of the switch-in level = on), then the following applies:
Sets the switch-in level for the Vdc_min controller for line droop control (BI: p5401[0] = 1 signal).

Sets the proportional gain for the DC-link voltage controller (Vdc_min controller, Vdc_max controller) in line droop operation (p5401). The controller output acts on the line droop. The additional power to change the DC link voltage is therefore internally multiplied with the gradient of the frequency droop (p5407, p5408).

descriere_scurta: Vdc_max controller automatic ON level detection
descriere: Activates/de-activates the automatic sensing of the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller.
Sets the configuration for the bypass function.
Sets the delay time to switch back to converter operation for a non-synchronized bypass.
Sets the delay time for switching to line operation for a non-synchronized bypass.
Sets the speed threshold to activate the bypass.
Sets the signal source for the control command to the bypass.
Sets the cause that should initiate the bypass.
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal "synchronization completed" for the bypass function.

In the simulation mode, the closed-loop control or U/f control can be operated without motor. The simulation mode is used to test the power unit. Even though the DC link voltage is missing, the pulses are enabled when powering up. The DC link pre-charging is bypassed and the undervoltage detection is disabled. Closed-loop speed control with an encoder is possible if the torque setpoint (r0079) is used in order to operate a second drive in the closed-loop torque controlled mode.
Sets the control word for the motor holding brake.

descriere_scurta: Motor holding brake standstill detection bypass
descriere: Sets the delay time for closing the brake at standstill. After this time has expired, if the "close brake at standstill" or OFF1/OFF3 is present, the brake is closed and the pulses are suppressed. For p1276 = 300.000 s, the timer is de-activated - this means that the timer output is always zero.

descriere_scurta: Motor holding brake braking threshold delay exceeded
descriere: Sets the delay time for the signal "braking threshold exceeded" (BO: r1229.6).

Sets the brake control type (with or without diagnostics evaluation). Example for brake control with diagnostics evaluation. - brake control in the Motor Modules in booksize format - Safe Brake Relay for AC Drive Example for brake control without diagnostics evaluation. - Brake Relay for AC Drive

descriere_scurta: Vdc_max controller automatic detection ON signal level (U/f)
descriere: Activates/de-activates the automatic sensing of the switch-in level for the Vdc_max controller. When the sensing function is de-activated, the activation threshold r1282 for the Vdc_max controller is determined from the parameterized connection voltage p0210.

Sets the percentage value for the asymmetry detection for the braking chopper. The ripple of the absolute current r0068 is monitored. The reference value is the average value of the absolute current. The minimum monitoring value is 10 % of the power unit rated current.

descriere_scurta: Travel to fixed stop evaluation torque reduction
descriere: Sets the evaluation for the torque/force reduction when traversing to a fixed stop.

Sets the speed threshold for the motoring/regenerative limit. For speeds where the absolute value is less than p1546, then the following applies: - For p1400.13 = 0: Motoring limit (speed threshold is compared to the speed actual value). - For p1400.13 = 1: Regenerative limiting (speed threshold is compared to the speed setpoint).
Sets the monitoring time of the excitation. After an ON command, the feedback signal must be received within this monitoring time.
Sets the switch-off delay time to shut down the excitation equipment.
Setting for activating/de-activating the 2nd order filter.
Sets the Vdc actual value filter 5 as low pass (PT2) or as extended general 2nd order filter.

descriere_scurta: Vdc actual value filter 5 denominator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the denominator natural frequency for the Vdc actual value filter 5 (PT2, general filter).

descriere_scurta: Vdc actual value filter 5 denominator damping
descriere: Sets the denominator damping for Vdc actual value filter 5.

descriere_scurta: Vdc actual value filter 5 numerator natural frequency
descriere: Sets the numerator natural frequency for the Vdc actual value filter 5 (general filter).

descriere_scurta: Vdc actual value filter 5 numerator damping
descriere: Sets the numerator damping for Vdc actual value filter 5.
Activates data acceptance for parameter changes for the filter.
